description_en: Queries statistics on API security risk domain names
description_zh: 查询API安全风险域名统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-abnormal-domain-statistic --instance-id waf-cn-45919n000 --cluster-id 428 --start-time 1682571600 --end-time 1687313820 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --order-way desc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApisecAbnormalDomainStatistic

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter is applicable only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number when using paging. Sets the current page number. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sort order of the list. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.

- **desc**: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
列表排序方式。取值：

- **asc**：正序。

- **desc**：倒序
parameters.name: order_way

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
